name: Sikafloor-215 Rapid Screed
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-215 RAPID SCREED: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed, May 2023, Version 01.07 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sikafloor-215-rapidscreed.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2023, Version 01.07).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed - a premium screed that is easy to apply with good working time, but also reaches a high strength with low moisture within 24hrs.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed is applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur®, SikaTite® & Davco® ranges
    - Applications are as follows
    - > Internal & external space
    - > Bonded screed from 10mm - 100mm
    - > Un-bonded screed from 30mm - 80mm
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: FAST-DRYING PRE-BLENDED ENGINEERED SCREED
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Complies with the requirements noted in
    - Section 1.3.12 & 3.3 of AS 1884:2021
    - Floor Coverings - Resilient sheet and tiles - Installation practices
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 1884:2021: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS 3958.1: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > APPLICATION (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - ▪ Pre-mixed binder with selected aggregates
    - ▪ High strength – ~40MPa after 28 days
    - ▪ Good working time 20-30min @ 23°C
    - ▪ Low shrinkage
    - ▪ Tiles may be installed after 15hrs
    - ▪ Suitable for all residential or commercial flooring installation
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Selected aggregates, cements, & additives
    - Appearance and colour: Grey powder with aggregates
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: ~22 MPa at 1 day; ~40 MPa at 28 days
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~7 MPa at 28 days
    - Reaction to fire: No hazardous combustion products are known
2.7 System structure.
    | Bonded Screed | Un-bonded Screed |
    | Polyethylene sheet |
    | Lankolatex 751 & GP cement mixed |
    | 1:1 |
    | Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed | Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed |
    | Subsequent suitable materials | Subsequent suitable materials |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg Bag - 48 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: Unopened bags can be stored for up to 12 months in a cool, dry and weatherproof environment.
    - Storage conditions: Bags must be stored off the floor. Avoid sitting bags in direct sunlight prior to application.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2023, Version 01.07) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. Concrete floors should be fully cured, structurally sound, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates and dust for Eg. For bonded coats the concrete must be porous and accept water penetration. Test by lightly sprinkling water on areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with Lanko Latex 751 & Cement Slurry can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed by the concrete surface contaminants are present and loss of adhesion may occur. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed before installation. Concrete must be free of efflorescence and not subject to hydrostatic pressure. If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) and moisture sensitive flooring is being installed Sikafloor® Moisture Barrier System may be considered (Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier + Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime + Lankolatex 751/GP cement). Contact your local Sika® office for further information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2023, Version 01.07) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 1.9 - 2.1 Litres of clean, cool water
    - Yield: 10L = 1m2 @ 10mm
    - Pot Life: 20 - 30 minutes @ 23°C
4.3 Waiting time to overcoating. Allow 15 hours at 23°C prior to the application of tile or levelling systems. Allow 3 days at 23°C for impervious floor coverings or membranes. Drying is dependent on thickness of application, temperature, air flow & relative humidity. Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures.
4.4 Equipment - Mixing can be undertaken with.
    - ▪ Slow speed mixing drill & pail
    - ▪ Cement mixer
    - ▪ Forced drum mixer
    - For best results a forced drum mixer or cement mixer is advised.
4.5 Mixing. Slowly add powder to the clean cool water and mix for a continuous 2-3 minutes. A semi-dry consistency must be achieved, but will form when pressure is applied. Install mixed product immediately. Not mixing for the recommended time or additional water may result in product irregularities and possible product failure.
4.6 Application.
    - Bonded Screed Application 10mm - 100mm
    - For bonded screed applications a Bond/Slurry coat must first be applied prior to placement of Sikafloor®- 215 Rapid Screed.Bonded screeds above 50mm must have galvanized wire installed as per AS 3958.1. Un-bonded Screeds Application: 30 - 80mm
    - Lay 2 layers of polyethylene film on the substrate and tape the joins. Place the mixed Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed onto the polyethelene film and reinforce with galvanized wire as per AS 3958.1. Screed to falls and desired heights should be created during this process. Bond/Slurry coat is Lankolatex 751/GP cement mixed 1:1 by ratio.
    - Apply Bond/Slurry coat to the substrate with a stiff broom making sure adequate slurry is observed on the surface. While the Bond /Slurry coat is still wet and tacky apply the Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed and compact (tamp). Screed to falls and desired heights should be created during this process.
    - Note: Should the Bond/ Slurry coat skin prior to placement of Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed, remove and replace prior to further product being installed.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and equipment with warm water and detergent while the product is still wet.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - ▪ The performance of cement-based materials is compromised when used above 35°C or below 5°C.
    - ▪ Do not apply over substrates that may be subject to shrinkage after application.
    - ▪ Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed is designed to be covered and not left exposed for long periods of time. ▪ Efflorescence in cement-based materials is beyond the control of the manufacturer.
    - ▪ Expansion joints and all other AS standards must be followed during the installation process.
    - ▪ Subsequent materials must be deemed as suitable and manufactures installation processes followed.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. 5°C - 35°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - ▪ The performance of cement-based materials is compromised when used above 35°C or below 5°C.
5.4 Basis of the stated values.
    - Manufactured in Australia.
    - All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed, May 2023, Version 01.07, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sikafloor-215-rapidscreed.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed, version 11/05/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sds-sikafloor-215rapidscreed.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed EPD, version 03/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sikafloor-215-rapidscreedepd.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaFloor: Resin Flooring Solutions, version 08/11/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/Sikafloor%20Resin%20BROCHURE%202023%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall referto the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containingphysical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-re-lated data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
